_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); net revenue, client assets, expense, trading activity and pre-tax margin signals with Schwab's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'The Charles Schwab Corporation (CSC) ... engages, through its subsidiaries (collectively referred to as the Company, and primarily located in San Francisco except as indicated), in securities brokerage, banking, and related financial services.' 'Developments in the business, economic, and geopolitical environment could negatively impact the Company’s business.' 'The Company’s industry is characterized by aggressive price competition.' (FY2008 10-K); DURABLE, risk 2: the 10-K ties results to markets, rates and investor engagement and names price competition, a cycle and a competitive field, and does not call its own business cyclical (the JPM, LOW and SHW reading); no theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a securities broker and bank on these dates (OFFSHORE is scoped to IT services), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

BEAR.desc: EPS -10.3%/yr (worst year FY03-FY08, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS -11.7%/yr (Q1 revenue YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 6.3-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +29.6%/yr (FY03-FY08 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +62.9%/yr (best 2-yr run FY03-FY08, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: SCHW (retrospective, 2009-04-24) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.05x (11.4% downside to Bear $15.81 / +234.2% upside to Bull $59.63) | Adj composite 2.15 vs market 1.50: gap +0.65 [UNDERVALUED] | -16% above the EPP floor $21.20 (20x FY09E $1.06) | Conservative 2-yr case: +45.4% total (+22.7%/yr) | At 16.8x FY09E the 15% hurdle price $23.59 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; revenue -15.0% YoY in Q1 2009, forward revenues -15% (Q1 2009 revenue growth (no Q2 2009 guide)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
